international.title: Fewer than half in UK will pay TV licence fee within a decade, report warns
international.summary: Analysis for thinktank points to cycle of falling income leading to lower spending on content in ‘spiral of decline’ Fewer than half of households in Britain will pay the BBC’s licence within a decade, according to analysis that warns that the broadcaster’s funding is locked in a “spiral of decline” . With senior BBC figures concerned about the accelerating fall in licence fee sales, the independent projections also warn that the proportion of households paying the levy will further decline to less than a third by 2037-38 should the government persist with the corporation’s current funding model.
